area-Build: Building WPF itself, including native compilation and repository build orchestration. Prefer area-Compilers for XAML markup compilation.
area-clipboard: WPF DataObject, clipboard formats, copying and pasting, and drag-and-drop data transfer.
area-Compilers: WPF XAML markup compilation, generated markup code, and PresentationBuildTasks. Prefer area-System.Xaml for runtime XAML reader or writer failures.
area-DataGrid: DataGrid behavior, columns, rows, cells, selection, and editing. A DataGrid appearing only in sample code is not enough.
area-Grid: Grid layout, row and column definitions, sizing, and shared-size behavior. Distinguish Grid from GridView and DataGrid.
area-Host: WPF HWND hosting and interoperability, including HwndHost, HwndSource, and hosted native or Windows Forms content.
area-IDE: WPF project and XAML tooling behavior in an IDE. Distinguish a tooling failure from a runtime failure in the application.
area-infrastructure: Repository automation, CI, test infrastructure, and contributor tooling rather than application runtime behavior.
area-Localization: WPF localization resources, localization tooling, and culture-specific resource loading.
area-NetSDK: .NET SDK targeting, framework references, and WPF SDK integration. Prefer WindowsDesktop SDK for a failure specifically isolated to desktop SDK targets.
area-Styling: WPF styles, setters, triggers, resource lookup, and style application. Prefer a specific control when the evidence isolates its behavior.
area-System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotatio: WPF integration with System.ComponentModel.DataAnnotations validation. An unrelated library validation issue is not enough.
area-System.IO: WPF-owned packaging and stream handling associated with System.IO. An unrelated file-system exception is not enough.
area-System.Xaml: Runtime System.Xaml readers, writers, object construction, schema context, and XAML serialization.
area-Templates: WPF ControlTemplate and DataTemplate instantiation, lookup, and application. Distinguish templates from ordinary styles.
area-Tooltip: ToolTip and ToolTipService display, placement, timing, and input behavior.
area-Touch: WPF touch, stylus, pen, and manipulation input. Input devices merely appearing in the configuration are not enough.
area-VirtualizingStackPanel: VirtualizingStackPanel realization, recycling, scrolling, and container lifetime. Prefer this over a containing control only when virtualization is the reported failing boundary.
GridView: GridView view behavior and columns, usually within ListView. Distinguish it from Grid layout and DataGrid.
ListView: ListView selection, items, containers, and view behavior not isolated to GridView or virtualization.
RichTextBox: RichTextBox editing, selection, document content, and formatting. An unrelated FlowDocument use is not enough.
TextBox: TextBox text entry, editing, selection, and related control behavior.
Win 11 Theming: WPF Windows 11 theme resources and theme-specific rendering or behavior. Running on Windows 11 alone is not enough.
WindowsDesktop SDK: WPF integration with Microsoft.NET.Sdk.WindowsDesktop targets and desktop project configuration.
